raw:
The 2002 Italian Grand Prix, round 15 of the 2002 season at Monza on 15 September 2002, was won by Rubens Barrichello driving for Ferrari. Michael Schumacher finished second and Eddie Irvine third.

ANSWER: Rubens Barrichello
